Parameter uncertainty about the true trend and mean also compounds over time.

Specific risks that could push outcomes outside my stated intervals include sudden macroeconomic shocks such as unexpected central bank policy shifts, geopolitical events, or major data releases that could trigger discontinuous jumps well beyond normal volatility bounds. On the downside, a risk-off episode, liquidity crisis, or negative fundamental shock could push values well below 778. Fat-tailed distributions mean these tail events are more probable than a Gaussian framework would suggest, and my intervals, while wide, may still understate true tail risk in stressed market environments.
